title: 2x Kohlrabi Korfu F1 Plug Plants – Crisp, Tender Roots - Hardy
description:
Kohlrabi Korfu F1 is a reliable, fast-growing variety producing

 tender, crisp roots

with a mild flavour. Best harvested young, between the size of a golf ball and a tennis ball. Excellent cooked, roasted, or sliced raw in salads.

 Product Details:

   Type:
  
  Kohlrabi Korfu F1 (Hybrid)
 

   Supplied As:
  
  2x plug plants
 

   Flavour:
  
  Mild, crisp, tender flesh
 

   Uses:
  
  Salads, cooking, roasting, stir-fries
 

 Growing Information:

   When to Sow/Plant:
  
  March – July
 

   Maturity/Harvest:
  
  From June onwards
 

   Planting Depth:
  
  1.5cm (½ inch)
 

   Spacing:
  
  15cm (6 inches) between plants, 30cm between rows
 

   Light:
  
  Full sun
 

   Temperature (for modules):
  
  ~13°C
 

 Tips:

  Sow successionally for a continuous crop.
 

  Harvest when roots are between golf ball and tennis ball size for best flavour.
 

  Can be started indoors in modules (2 seeds per cell, thin to 1).
 

  Gradually harden off before planting outside.
 

  Slice and fry gently in olive oil, or use as a substitute for turnips.
